title: Microsoft 365 Incident Response
description: Microsoft 365 service incidents affecting construction operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on construction operations and site communications
Implement alternative communication methods if needed
Activate service desk for user support
investigation_steps: Check Microsoft 365 service status from vendor portal
Review Microsoft 365 admin center for issues
Verify network connectivity to Microsoft services
resolution_steps: Contact Microsoft support for service issues
Coordinate with Microsoft for service restoration
verification: Confirm with construction staff that services are operational
special_considerations: Site communications are critical for construction operations
Field teams may have limited connectivity alternatives
Maintain communication with site managers during outages
Document any service interruptions that may affect project timelines
